Will make your second Tasker quick tile into a toggle that will set your screen time out alternately to 10 minutes and your normal timeout setting. This can be very useful for situations where you're reading an article online for a prolonged time and don't want to always have to touch the screen to keep it on.

With this task, simply tap the quick tile and read away! When you're done reading, tap the icon again or simply turn off your screen for the timeout to go back to normal!

Full tutorial here!

Will create several useful display-related variables that you can use anywhere in your projects:

  • %AOD: Will be set to 1 if the Always-On-Display is showing, unset if not. Can be used to show info-only scenes on your AOD with Blocking Overlay + type scenes
  • %DisplayOn: Will be set to 1 if the Display is on, unset if not (can be locked or not locked).
  • %Locked: Will be set to 1 if the Display is locked, unset if not (display can be on or off). Can be used to destroy scenes that you don't want to show while the phone is unlocked for example.
  • %LockScreen: Will be set to 1 if the Lock Screen is showing (while the display is on), unset if not. Can be used to show interactive scenes on your Lock Screen with Blocking Overlay + type scenes

Updated Task for Freeform Window or Floating Window

This task is a slight revision of the original [HOW-TO] Launch app in freeform window or pop-up view. The original task did not work as expected on some devices. This updated version is designed to function properly, and you might want to try this version if you're facing issues with the original task.

Purpose/Function of the Task:

The goal of this task is to launch an app in freeform mode or as a pop-up view on your device. By using this task, you can control the size and position of app windows, allowing them to function in a floating window format. This is particularly useful for multitasking or when you need to run apps side by side.

Tested on:

  • Device: Poco X3 GT or Xiaomi Redmi Note 10 Pro
  • OS: Android 13
  • MIUI: 14

Date: April 16, 2025

Action.label: mem-dashboard
Action.Str:
MEM_INFO=$(cat /proc/meminfo) SWAPS=$(cat /proc/swaps)
RAM_T=$(echo "$MEM_INFO" | awk '/MemTotal/ {print int($2/1024)}') RAM_F=$(echo "$MEM_INFO" | awk '/MemFree/ {print int($2/1024)}') RAM_U=$(( RAM_T - RAM_F ))
Z_U=$(echo "$SWAPS" | grep "zram" | awk '{sum+=$4} END {print int(sum/1024)}') [ -z "$Z_U" ] && Z_U=0
D_U=$(echo "$SWAPS" | grep -v "zram" | grep -v "Filename" | awk '{sum+=$4} END {print int(sum/1024)}') [ -z "$D_U" ] && D_U=0
echo "RAM: ${RAM_U}/${RAM_T}MB | ZRAM: ${Z_U}MB | DISK: ${D_U}MB"

cat > /data/data/com.termux/files/home/.termux/tasker/hidrunner.sh <<'EOF' #!/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/bash set -u
FIFO="/data/local/tmp/pixel_keyboard.fifo" PIDFILE="/data/local/tmp/pixel_keyboard.pid"
start() { if [ -f "$PIDFILE" ] && kill -0 "$(cat "$PIDFILE")" 2>/dev/null; then echo "hidrunner already running: $(cat "$PIDFILE")" exit 0 fi
# Make FIFO (root-required path) rm -f "$FIFO" mkfifo "$FIFO" chmod 666 "$FIFO"
# Start hid in background and keep it alive by holding stdin open. ( # Register a keyboard device and keep stdin open forever. # NOTE: hid reads JSON from stdin; we keep it alive by feeding it from FIFO. # The "cat $FIFO" blocks, which is exactly what we want. cat "$FIFO" | /system/bin/hid ) &
echo $! > "$PIDFILE" echo "hidrunner started: $(cat "$PIDFILE")" }
stop() { if [ -f "$PIDFILE" ]; then pid="$(cat "$PIDFILE")" if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true fi rm -f "$PIDFILE" fi
# Remove FIFO (optional) rm -f "$FIFO" echo "hidrunner stopped" }
case "${1:-}" in start) start ;; stop) stop ;; *) echo "Usage: $0 {start|stop}" exit 1 ;; esac EOF chmod 700 /data/data/com.termux/files/home/.termux/tasker/hidrunner.sh

# 1. Setup the Database in a neutral zone DB="/data/adb/villain_leaderboard.txt" [ ! -f "$DB" ] && touch "$DB"
# 2. Get Thermal Status (0-6) # Higher status = Higher multiplier for points THERMAL=$(dumpsys thermal | grep "Thermal Status" | awk '{print $NF}') [ -z "$THERMAL" ] && THERMAL=0
# Multiplier: Status 0-1 = 1x | Status 2 = 2x | Status 3+ = 3x if [ "$THERMAL" -le 1 ]; then MULT=1; elif [ "$THERMAL" -eq 2 ]; then MULT=2; else MULT=3; fi
# 3. Process the Top 10 CPU Hogs # We assign points: #1 gets 10pts, #10 gets 1pt # Multiplied by the thermal state of the phone top -n 1 -b -o %CPU,NAME | head -n 17 | tail -n 10 | awk '{print $1, $2}' | while read -r cpu name; do [ -z "$name" ] && continue
# Simple rank-based points POINTS=$(( (10 - count) * MULT ))
if grep -q "$name" "$DB"; then # Update existing score SCORE=$(grep "$name" "$DB" | awk '{print $1}') NEW_SCORE=$((SCORE + POINTS)) sed -i "s/.*$name/$NEW_SCORE $name/" "$DB" else # Add new entry echo "$POINTS $name" >> "$DB" fi done
# 4. Sort the Leaderboard (highest score at top) sort -rn "$DB" -o "$DB"

Action.label: cpu-dashboard
Action.Str:
F0=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cpufreq/scaling_cur_freq 2>/dev/null) F1=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu1/cpufreq/scaling_cur_freq 2>/dev/null) F2=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu2/cpufreq/scaling_cur_freq 2>/dev/null) F3=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu3/cpufreq/scaling_cur_freq 2>/dev/null) F4=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu4/cpufreq/scaling_cur_freq 2>/dev/null) F5=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu5/cpufreq/scaling_cur_freq 2>/dev/null) F6=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu6/cpufreq/scaling_cur_freq 2>/dev/null) F7=$(cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu7/cpufreq/scaling_cur_freq 2>/dev/null)
G0=$(awk -v k="$F0" 'BEGIN{if(k==""){printf "0.00"}else{printf "%.2f", k/1000000}}') G1=$(awk -v k="$F1" 'BEGIN{if(k==""){printf "0.00"}else{printf "%.2f", k/1000000}}') G2=$(awk -v k="$F2" 'BEGIN{if(k==""){printf "0.00"}else{printf "%.2f", k/1000000}}') G3=$(awk -v k="$F3" 'BEGIN{if(k==""){printf "0.00"}else{printf "%.2f", k/1000000}}') G4=$(awk -v k="$F4" 'BEGIN{if(k==""){printf "0.00"}else{printf "%.2f", k/1000000}}') G5=$(awk -v k="$F5" 'BEGIN{if(k==""){printf "0.00"}else{printf "%.2f", k/1000000}}') G6=$(awk -v k="$F6" 'BEGIN{if(k==""){printf "0.00"}else{printf "%.2f", k/1000000}}') G7=$(awk -v k="$F7" 'BEGIN{if(k==""){printf "0.00"}else{printf "%.2f", k/1000000}}')
printf "S (0-1): %s %s
M (2-4): %s %s %s
U (5-6): %s %s
P (7) : %s" "$G0" "$G1" "$G2" "$G3" "$G4" "$G5" "$G6" "$G7"
